recommended_steps.detail: Read section 24 of the namespace brief and accept or change which checks moved to touch, whole-sequence operations and diagnose. Its last amendment has had no independent review.
recommended_steps.title: Accept the moved-detection statement

recommended_steps.detail: Decide whether a derived event-membership table in the content store's index is acceptable before Phase 13 removes publication's full check; see the pending user action.
recommended_steps.title: Decide the Phase 13 membership question

see_for_yourself.expected: Identical SQL statement and entry-validation counts at 100 and 5000 entries, then diagnose refusing after a corruption the reads did not touch; temporary data is removed.
see_for_yourself.title: Compare work at two namespace sizes

what_just_landed.detail: Ordinary open, admission, reads and metadata changes validate only the records they touch, so their work no longer grows with the namespace or the content store.
what_just_landed.title: Namespace work now costs what it touches

what_just_landed.detail: Touched damage refuses and stops the handle; untouched damage is found on touch, by whole-sequence operations or by diagnose. A mutation never records a refusal that rests on a damaged record.
what_just_landed.title: Damage still fails closed

what_just_landed.detail: An operator procedure converts an existing namespace after writing a verified backup; ordinary open never migrates.
what_just_landed.title: Explicit v1 to v2 migration
